story.iWant: robust CRUD for all suppliers with import/export
story.soThat: AP tracking, validations, and integration to bills/payments is seamless

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. List view: Supports pagination (20 per page), sorting by name or code, filter on status (active/inactive), and typeahead search. 2. Add form: All required except for optional fields; real-time validation (e.g., phone number, email format, tax code checksum). 3. Autogenerates Supplier Code (SUP-YYYY-NNNN) and ensures globally unique per company; number increments even if prior code deleted/deactivated. 4. Detect and reject duplicate suppliers by tax code (and optionally email/cell), displaying exactly where conflict occurred. 5. Inactive suppliers appear grayed-out and are moved to bottom or separate tab. 6. Users can deactivate/reactivate, with tooltip explaining that linked AP data will not be deleted. 7. CRUD actions update real-time (websockets or polling), so multiple users see live changes. 8. Show supplier AP summary (open bills, total owed, average payment days) in details panel. 9. Can export supplier list to CSV/Excel. 10. Attempt to delete supplier with existing bills/payments blocked, with explanatory modal. 11. All field edits, activations/deactivations, and import actions logged to the audit trail with before/after data and responsible user.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR17: Supplier Master Data Management, FR18: Create Purchase Bills, FR19: Record Payments for Purchase Bills, FR20: AP Aging Report, NFR23: i18n Support
doc.snippet: The system must support CRUD operations for suppliers with fields for code (auto-gen), name, tax code, address, etc., linked to account 331. Suppliers are used in purchase bills and AP tracking.

doc.title: Epic 2 Technical Specification
doc.section: Story 2.3: Supplier Master Data Management (CRUD), Supplier Entity, Supplier API, Supplier CRUD Workflow
doc.snippet: Epic 2: Master Data Management establishes foundational data governance. Supplier Master Data: Full CRUD operations for supplier records with auto-generated codes (SUP-YYYY-NNNN), duplicate detection by tax code, status management (active/inactive), AP summary integration, and import/export functionality. Supplier entity includes: id, company_id, code, name, tax_code, address, email, phone, active, createdAt, updatedAt.

doc.title: Epic Breakdowns
doc.snippet: As an accountant, I want robust CRUD for all suppliers with import/export, so that AP tracking, validations, and integration to bills/payments is seamless. List view supports pagination, sorting, filtering. Auto-generates Supplier Code (SUP-YYYY-NNNN). Detect and reject duplicate suppliers by tax code.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.section: Data Architecture, Multi-Tenancy Strategy, Technology Stack Details
doc.snippet: Enterprise accounting ERP system using Spring Boot 3.5.7 backend with React TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL via Supabase. Multi-tenancy: Row-level filtering via company_id on all tables. Search: PostgreSQL FTS + unaccent for native Vietnamese unaccented search support. Database schema: snake_case table names (suppliers), UUID primary keys.

doc.title: Story 2.3
doc.section: Dev Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Tasks, Learnings from Previous Story
doc.snippet: Multi-tenancy: All supplier records must be company-scoped. Use CompanyScopedEntity interface pattern from Epic 1. Supplier code format: SUP-YYYY-NNNN. Tax code validation: 10-digit Vietnamese tax codes. Duplicate detection by tax code (required) and optionally email/phone. Referential integrity: Suppliers cannot be deleted if linked to bills/payments. Vietnamese search using PostgreSQL unaccent extension. Learnings from Story 2.2 (Customer): REUSE patterns for SupplierService, SupplierCodeGenerator, SupplierImportExportService, and frontend components.

constraints.constraint: Multi-tenancy: All supplier records must be company-scoped. Use CompanyScopedEntity interface pattern from Epic 1. All queries automatically filtered by company_id via CompanyContext.

Database schema: Follow PostgreSQL conventions: snake_case table names (suppliers), UUID primary keys (or BIGSERIAL), foreign keys with proper constraints. Unique constraint: UNIQUE(company_id, tax_code) at database level.

Supplier code format: Auto-generated codes follow pattern SUP-YYYY-NNNN where YYYY is current year and NNNN is sequential number (e.g., SUP-2025-0001). Code generation must be thread-safe to prevent duplicates under concurrency. Use database sequence or atomic counter. Handle year rollover (reset sequence on new year).

Tax code validation: Vietnamese tax codes are 10-digit numeric strings. Validate format and enforce uniqueness per company via UNIQUE(company_id, tax_code) constraint. Use @Pattern annotation for format validation.

Duplicate detection: Check for duplicates by tax code (required), and optionally by email and phone number. When duplicate found, return 409 Conflict with details showing conflicting supplier (code, name, tax code). Display exactly where conflict occurred in error message.

Referential integrity: Suppliers cannot be deleted if they have linked bills or payments (Epic 4 data). Check references before deletion, return 409 Conflict with explanatory message listing count of linked records. Option to deactivate instead of delete. For MVP, stub referential check until Epic 4 implemented.

Vietnamese search: Use PostgreSQL unaccent extension for unaccented search support (NFR23). Create custom function unaccent_search(text) in Flyway migration for use in search queries. Search must match accented field reliably (e.g., "nha" matches "nhà").

Audit logging: All supplier CRUD operations must be logged to audit_logs table with before/after values in JSONB format. Include user ID, company ID, timestamp, IP address, user agent. Import operations create one audit entry per imported row. Log blocked delete attempts with reason. Address unresolved review items from Customer story: User ID retrieval in audit logging (connect SecurityContext), referential integrity check for delete, import audit logging verification, export audit logging.

Import/export: Use Apache POI for Excel parsing. Import must be atomic (all valid rows or none). Validate all rows before saving, collect errors, return error report with row numbers. Export supports CSV and Excel formats with applied filters. Log export action in audit trail.
Real-time updates: For MVP, use polling every 5 minutes to refresh supplier list. WebSocket support can be added post-MVP. CRUD actions update real-time so multiple users see live changes.

AP summary integration: Supplier AP summary (open bills, total owed, average payment days) requires Epic 4 (AP Module) data. For MVP, stub the summary or return placeholder values. Show placeholder message if AP data not available.

Frontend: Use shadcn/ui components (not MUI) - architecture uses shadcn/ui. Follow feature-first structure: pages in features/suppliers/pages/, components in features/suppliers/components/. Use TanStack Table (data-table-09 pattern) for supplier list. Use Dialog component (not Sheet) for supplier add/edit form following Customer story pattern.

RBAC: All authenticated users can view suppliers; edit requires admin/accountant roles. Use @PreAuthorize annotations for API security. Frontend UI hiding is not a security boundary - API must enforce permissions.

Form validation: Use React Hook Form with Zod schema validation. Real-time validation: show inline errors on field blur. Validate phone number format, email format, tax code format (10-digit Vietnamese tax code). Form organized into three sections: Primary Information, Contact Details, Status & Settings.

Inactive supplier display: Inactive suppliers appear grayed-out (reduced opacity) and are moved to bottom or separate tab (user preference). Deactivate/reactivate with tooltip explaining that linked AP data will not be deleted.

Learnings from Customer story: REUSE patterns from CustomerService, CustomerCodeGenerator, CustomerImportExportService, and frontend components. Address unresolved review items: User ID retrieval in audit logging (HIGH), referential integrity check for delete (HIGH), import audit logging verification (MEDIUM), export audit logging (MEDIUM), search pagination limitation (MEDIUM), inactive supplier sorting verification (LOW).

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test with TestContainers for integration tests. Mockito for service unit tests (code generation, validation, duplicate detection). Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library + jsdom for component tests. Integration: Test full supplier flow: create → edit → deactivate → view AP summary → export → import. Performance: Measure supplier list load time (< 2s target per NFR1) for 1000+ suppliers. Accessibility: Test keyboard navigation, screen reader support (WCAG AA compliance).

Frontend test: Verify form validation - phone number format, email format, tax code format (10-digit), required fields
Unit test: Verify SupplierCodeGenerator generates SUP-YYYY-NNNN format, ensures uniqueness per company, increments correctly, handles year rollover, thread-safe
Integration test: Verify duplicate detection by tax code (required) and optionally email/phone - returns 409 Conflict with conflicting supplier details
Frontend test: Verify inactive suppliers appear grayed-out (reduced opacity) and moved to bottom or separate tab
Frontend test: Verify deactivate/reactivate functionality with tooltip explaining linked AP data preserved
Integration test: Verify real-time updates via polling (5-minute intervals) - multiple users see live changes
Integration test: Verify supplier AP summary (stubbed for MVP) - returns placeholder values until Epic 4 implemented
Integration test: Verify export functionality - generates CSV/Excel with applied filters, includes all supplier fields, logs export action
Integration test: Verify delete blocked if supplier has linked bills/payments - returns 409 Conflict with explanatory message, option to deactivate (stubbed for MVP until Epic 4)

Integration test: Verify audit logging - all CRUD operations logged with before/after values, import operations create one audit entry per row, blocked delete attempts logged. Verify User ID retrieval from SecurityContext (addresses unresolved review item from Customer story).
Integration test: Verify company scoping - suppliers from different companies are isolated, queries filtered by company_id
Integration test: Verify import atomicity - all valid rows or none, error report with row numbers, export with filters
Performance test: Verify supplier list load time < 2s for 1000+ suppliers, search with unaccented Vietnamese < 500ms
Frontend test: Verify keyboard navigation, screen reader support, ARIA labels on all interactive elements
